title: Deployment Rollout Failures - Pods Refusing to Become Ready
description: In this lab you will diagnose a deployment rollout that has stalled because newly deployed pods are failing their readiness probes. You will trace the failure from the deployment status through to the pod events, identify the misconfigured probe endpoint, and then choose between fixing the configuration and rolling back to restore full availability. This is a common CKA and CKAD troubleshooting scenario.
